name: What should I do immediately if my toilet backs up into the tub?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if my toilet backs up into the tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your toilet is backing up into the tub, the first step is to stop using all water fixtures in your home, especially the toilet, sink, and shower. This prevents more water from entering the clogged drain and potentially overflowing. Do not try to flush the toilet again, as this will worsen the backup. Avoid using chemical drain cleaners, as they are often ineffective on severe clogs and can damage pipes or pose a hazard to plumbers. Contact a professional plumber promptly to assess the situation and clear the blockage safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stop using all water fixtures immediately, especially the toilet and tub. Do not flush again or use chemical drain cleaners, and call a professional plumber.
